items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:17:1
items.html:
The reason for this Kli, etc. — they are the discernment of the Nukva, the Gevurot and the females within the Hassadim themselves: As mentioned above, those AHP that ascend to her from the lower degree, and return and connect with the Nukva by the force of the upper coupling of AVI, which lowers the bottom Hey from her Einayim, are the vessel that raises the MAN. And this is what he says, “that they are three times AB, from the SAG, MA and BON of AB”: meaning, this illumination, which returns these three vessels of AHP, comes to her from the light of the coupling of AB and SAG, of which the illumination of AB lowers the bottom Hey from her Einayim, because there is no source for the bottom Hey in the Einayim in the discernment of AB, as is known — for only SAG is the beginning of the source for the rising of the bottom Hey in the Einayim. Therefore, whenever the coupling of AB and SAG is made, the illumination of AB immediately lowers the bottom Hey from the Einayim. Therefore it is discerned that in these three Sefirot of AHP — which are Bina, ZA and the Nukva — there are three illuminations of the HaVaYaH of AB, namely, according to the lights that pertain to those vessels, which are Neshama, Ruach and Nefesh, called SAG, MA and BON, as is known. And this is what he says, that they are three discernments of AB, as explained.
And this is what he says, “namely, from the first Hey downward, all of which are the discernment of the Nukva — the Gevurot and the females within the Hassadim themselves, by means of which she can receive the upper Hassadim, which are the male AB”: meaning, however much the Nukva lacks her posteriors, which are Bina and ZON, even though she has GE, still she is unfit to receive the upper Hassadim, that is, her GAR; and she has only Ruach and Nefesh. But now, after she has attained her posteriors, which are the discernments of the females of the Hassadim — namely, the Hey, the Vav and her bottom Hey, which are the discernments of the NRN [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama] of AB, as above — now she can receive the Mochin of her GAR, which are the male AB. For the GAR are always the discernment of the male, and the VAK are the discernments of the female. And he informs us that although all the renewal that she attained by virtue of the illumination of the coupling of AB and SAG is only the discernment of the females in her, which are from Bina downward, nevertheless, in the order of the lights, she attained her GAR, namely, the male AB.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:17:2
items.html: Ibur — AB and RIU — to teach that there is no Ibur in the world except through the two of them together: Their meaning is the posterior vessels, Bina and ZON, which are the square of the HaVaYaH of BON, which is RIU [216] in Gematria (as above, item 10); and also the discernment of the Ruach in them, which are the three discernments of AB, which are RIU in Gematria, as above. And afterwards the upper Mochin themselves, which are the male AB, as above. For with these AB and RIU the Gadlut of the Nukva is completed, as is the vessel that raises the MAN — which are the above Bina and ZON — by which vessel the anterior vessels of the souls of the righteous are raised to her (as above, page 741, the passage beginning “And you see”). And then ZA and the Nukva couple upon these MAN and give birth to the discernment of the Katnut of the souls of the righteous, which are the Mochin of Ibur. It follows that the Nukva cannot conceive the souls of the righteous except after she has attained the above AB and RIU; therefore they are intimated in the word Ibur.
